text_block_list.name: Rose's Mother
text_block_list.text:
—Long ago. Crossing over from France to Japan,
our venerable ancestor made a prayer.

text_block_list.name: Rose's Mother
text_block_list.text:
“Upon the cornerstone of my victory, grant our clan
eternal prosperity, and peace like that of an unshakeable kingdom.”

text_block_list.name: Rose's Mother
text_block_list.text: Yet, she never managed to fulfill it herself.

text_block_list.name: Rose's Mother
text_block_list.text: And so, the Trainer who invited her to the lands of Japan swore an oath.

text_block_list.name: Rose's Mother
text_block_list.text:
“One day, an heir to your will shall surely appear.
If so, I too shall raise one
who can support them upon that path.”

text_block_list.name: A Trainer
text_block_list.text:
“O glorious Rose Clan.
Until the day your kingdom is founded,
I shall remain ever at your side to support you――”

text_block_list.name: Rose's Mother
text_block_list.text: This is the immortal covenant handed down unbroken between my house and the Trainers who have served us.

text_block_list.name: Rose's Mother
text_block_list.text:
...Once again, congratulations on entering Tracen Academy,
Rose. You are our... bud of hope.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I offer my deepest gratitude for all the days you supported me.
—Mother.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: I shall surely achieve that long-cherished GⅠ victory and break the curse of thorns once and for all.
And so my lord—whom I was to serve as a retainer and guide as a Trainer—arrived at Tracen Academy.

In her heart,
she cradled a single rose, yet to bloom.

—In front of the main gate, where no one had yet arrived.
I pulled up the car and straightened my collar in the rearview mirror.
The formal attire I hadn't donned in quite some time still felt a little stiff.
(*Knock, knock*)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
—Right on time, thank you.
The tie suits you very well.
choice_data_list: ローズ様。どうぞ、お座席へ

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
—Right on time, thank you.
The dress suits you very well.
choice_data_list: ローズ様。どうぞ、お座席へ

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
Let us go—to our family estate.

Tonight, a lavish banquet is to be held
to celebrate Rose Kingdom's debut.

Distinguished guests gathered from far and wide, both within and beyond the clan,
to celebrate her new beginning and radiant future.

After driving for a while, we took a short break
at a rest area per her request.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Thank you.
I wanted to catch my breath before arriving.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
—Tonight, you shall also be the center of attention.
Are you accustomed to high society?
choice_data_list: 人並みには、心得ているつもりです

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: ...I see. Come to think of it, I still know very little of your past.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Why did you begin
serving my clan?

Asked the question, I trace back through my memories. It all began
with an encounter with the Rose Clan running upon the turf.

text_block_list.name: Rose Clan Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I didn't... make it—!! Again...
Again, so close!! Just a little more...
Just a tiny bit more... and yet—!!

Though victorious in countless graded stakes,
ever falling one step short of a G1 crown.
—A lineage ensnared by a curse of thorns.

And the presence of the countless Trainers who stood by as allies,
faithfully supporting that clan through the years.

Even across the passage of countless eras, it never withers—
a vivid thirst for victory, and a deep devotion to the clan.

Vows and wishes from the distant past—until they fulfill them, they will surely never halt their stride.
Before I knew it, I was utterly captivated by their brilliance.

Just then, I was approached by a senior Trainer
who was already an ally of the Rose Clan.

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Your ability stands head and shoulders above the other academy trainees.
That is precisely why I am scouting you.

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Will you become the Trainer who pursues
the Rose Clan's deepest yearning alongside me?
And so, I was welcomed into the fold as Trainer for the House of Roses.

And the one introduced alongside the numerous "Trainer candidates"
was the rare prodigy destined to carry the next generation—Rose Kingdom.

text_block_list.name: Rose (Years Ago)
text_block_list.text: Taaah!!

Watching her from afar, she was always striving with all her might.
Bearing immense expectations and a cherished ambition on her small shoulders, she trained relentlessly without a single complaint.

text_block_list.name: Rose (Years Ago)
text_block_list.text:
A kingdom of roses, where all those dear to me
may live on with smiles upon their faces.

text_block_list.name: Rose (Years Ago)
text_block_list.text:
The 'dream' our ancestors entrusted to us――
I shall be the one to fulfill it!

Her eyes sparkling as she made her proud declaration.
Basking in the light and applause, earnestly taking on every expectation—

Before they even realized it,
an unmistakable resolve had begun to sprout.

The night I triumphed, was chosen, and entrusted
with our clan's mission, my heart surged so that I could not sleep.
choice_data_list: こうしてお話しできる日々を夢見てきました

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
—It is deeply reassuring to have someone like you
bearing this grand ambition by my side.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Your competence as a Trainer goes without saying, but your fervent desire for my victory was what truly gave me strength.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Let us strive to build our kingdom together.
If it is us, we shall surely achieve it.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...
However, the coffee you brought earlier
carried a peculiar flavor, yet an undeniably addictive one.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I wonder what manner of extraction method
the barista employed.
choice_data_list: あれは、コーヒーマシンのものにございます

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I see. Small wonder, then...
It was indeed a flavor unfamiliar to me.
Before long, we arrived at the resplendent party hall.

Enveloped in dazzling lights and music—
people approached her one after another, exchanging courteous greetings.

text_block_list.name: Soirée Guest A
text_block_list.text:
Allow me to extend my congratulations once more,
Lady Rose Kingdom, Trainer-sama.

text_block_list.name: Soirée Guest B
text_block_list.text:
I hear you are a radiant soul who carries the future.
I look forward to the day your crimson petals bloom.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Yes. Once the crimson petals bloom, I will be sure to show you the beautiful future that lies beyond.

text_block_list.name: Rose Clan Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
To think that the little one who never went anywhere
without her stuffed dog
would grow into such a magnificent horse girl.

text_block_list.name: Rose Clan Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Listen to me... You have been blessed with talent since childhood.
I know you can break free of this curse of thorns and carve out the future.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Dearest sisters—

text_block_list.name: Young Rose Clan Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Please, Rose-oneesama, spread the renown
of our clan far and wide across the world.

text_block_list.name: Young Rose Clan Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
So that it will never, ever fade.
So that we do not become a bloodline that ended without a single GⅠ victory.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Yes, of course.
I shall certainly see our long-cherished wish fulfilled.

text_block_list.name: Top Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Trainer <username>!
Make sure you support Lady Rose with unwavering devotion.

text_block_list.name: Rose Clan Trainer
text_block_list.text: You can do it! If you ever need anything, I'm always here for you. Give it your all!

Without a trace of hesitation,
Rose Kingdom nods in acceptance
of all the expectations placed upon her.

As I followed that small yet noble silhouette,
the glittering night had deepened before I realized it.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
No, there is no need.
I must greet everyone at once. Besides—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Recalling everyone's encouraging words filled with high hopes,
I do not feel in the slightest like sitting down to rest right now.
choice_data_list: 承知しました。……お心のままに

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...—
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: My dream is the founding and prosperity of the 'Rose Kingdom.'

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
To establish the Rose Clan's presence in the racing world
as unyielding and mighty as a great empire.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
To that end, first and foremost,
I must achieve our long-cherished GⅠ victory.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...
15 graded stakes victories, 33 G1 challenges—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
On our thirty-fourth attempt, I shall put an end to it.
For there are no thorns that cannot be severed.

text_block_list.name: Rose Clan Servant
text_block_list.text: Lady Rose, it is time.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Ah—
Parting through the glamorous buzz of the crowd, Rose Kingdom stepped forward into the center of the banquet.

The applause, the smiles, even the glint of crystal glasses—
everything held its breath, awaiting her words.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
To all who are gathered here.
Consider this a banquet of beginnings.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: —I ask that you entrust everything to me.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Let us stack victory upon victory,
and forge a radiant, eternal kingdom!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Toward a future where the crimson rose blooms!

text_block_list.name: People
text_block_list.text: Toward a future where the crimson rose blooms!

All for the sake of the Rose Clan—
To build the Rose Kingdom and weave our future.

And for that purpose,
the Twinkle Series begins.

color_text_info_list.Text: トゥインクル・シリーズ
